# dsh-theme-endfield-style
English | 中文

A theme in the style of *Arknights: Endfield* for the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
Unofficial fan work,
not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's publisher.
| Light | Dark |
## What it changes

- Fluorescent-yellow sidebar header and a signal rail on the right edge.
- A masthead with a large `

DEEPFIELD` background word and procedurally drawn contour lines.
- Engineering grey-white and graphi

te-black palettes that follow the built-in light / dark / system setting.
- Small corner radii, thin
lines, and a shortcut to the built-in Appearance settings in the sidebar.
All artwork is generated in code. There are no image files from the game, no network requests, and n
nerated in code. There are no image files from the game, no network requests, and no animation loop.

## Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The theme only adds a `<style>` tag, a few decorative elements, and a `data-endfield-theme` attribut
e on `<html>`. Removing the plugin removes all of them.
## Compatibility
Selectors use DSH's hashed component class names (for example `.hHd-Xa_root`). They were verified ag
ainst DSH `0.1.5-rc.3`. A newer DSH may rename them, and parts of the theme may stop applying until
the selectors are updated. Please open an issue with your DSH version if that happens.
